acceptanceCriteria: Each built-in detector class is reported from journal data alone, with no project scripts.
A project plugin's findings appear alongside the built-ins.
doctor --line prints free lanes, running sessions, 24 h completions and alert count from cache.
Spec requirements recorded and owner-accepted; #715 answered on the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#715. Pluggable corvint-tasks doctor (or health --queue): built-in detectors fed by dispatcher journal, pool state, attempt records and process trees for no-progress hand-offs, false idle (walk process tree), repeat refusal of the same final candidate, setup-only proof, preflight failures (#713), slow lane recovery (confirm-safe retries); plugin directory of executables emitting JSON {kind, who, detail}; JSON output plus cached one-line summary readable in <50 ms without locks; findings carry remedy text and stable kind with age-out tracking.
title: GH #715: corvint-tasks doctor pluggable queue health detectors with cached status-line summary
